title: Pure Engine Token
summary: Bandit Keith and Yako Tenma's Engine Token (Motor) DARK Machine deck, reinforced with Scrap Recycler, Clockwork Night, and Therion "King" Regulus. Every Motor monster generates Level 1 EARTH Machine Engine Tokens (200 ATK / 200 DEF) that fuel Tribute Summons, Link-1 Clockwork Knight plays, and Ancient Gear Ballista climbs.

summary.title: Starters
points: Scrap Recycler sends Motor Shell or Fiendish Engine Omega directly from the Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon, immediately turning on Two-for-One Repair Job and Therion "King" Regulus.
Motor Shell automatically Special Summons 1 Level 1 EARTH Machine Engine Token whenever it is sent from the field to the GY, whether Tributed, destroyed, or used as Link Material.

Two-for-One Repair Job banishes 1 DARK Machine from your GY to Special Summon any monster that mentions Engine Token (Fiendish Engine Omega, Motor Kaiser, Motor Frenzy, or Motor Shell) from your hand, Deck, or GY.

summary.title: Opening: Scrap Recycler + Two-for-One Repair Job
steps: Normal Summon Scrap Recycler and send Motor Shell from the Deck to the GY.
Activate Two-for-One Repair Job, banishing Motor Shell from the GY to Special Summon a second Motor Shell (or Motor Kaiser) from the Deck.
Link Summon Platinum Gadget using Scrap Recycler and Motor Shell; Motor Shell's GY effect triggers to Special Summon a Level 1 EARTH Machine Engine Token.
Use the Engine Token to Link Summon Clockwork Knight, searching Clockwork Night, then use Clockwork Knight to Tribute a Machine and revive Scrap Recycler from the GY for another dump.

summary.title: Engine Token Mechanics
summary.text: Because Engine Tokens are Level 1 EARTH Machine Normal Monsters, a single Engine Token satisfies the exact material requirement for Clockwork Knight (1 non-Link Machine with 1000 or less base ATK) or Link Spider, while two Engine Tokens make Ancient Gear Ballista. Motor Kaiser reveals itself in hand to perform an immediate Normal Summon of a DARK Machine (Tributing an Engine Token or Motor Shell), then destroys 1 monster you control on the field to spawn another Engine Token. Motor Frenzy gains ATK from the DEF of the Machine Tributed for it and spawns 2 Engine Tokens when sent to the GY after being Tribute Summoned.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Therion "King" Regulus Special Summons itself from the hand by equipping Motor Shell or Scrap Recycler from your GY. When Regulus sends the equipped Motor Shell to the GY to negate an opponent's card or effect, Motor Shell's effect triggers again because it was sent from the field to the GY, spawning an Engine Token on the opponent's turn.
Fiendish Engine Omega (2800 base ATK) boosts itself by 1000 ATK (to 3800 ATK) and Special Summons an Engine Token in Attack Position during every End Phase.
Ancient Gear Ballista pops a Spell or Trap (including Clockwork Night) to drop an opponent's monster to 0 ATK/DEF for lethal battle damage.

summary.title: Spells
points: Clockwork Night turns all face-up monsters on the field into Machines, boosts your Machines and Engine Tokens by 500 ATK while weakening opposing monsters by 500 ATK, and banishes itself from the GY with 1 discard to search Therion "King" Regulus or Scrap Recycler.

Two-for-One Repair Job also has a GY effect: when your face-up DARK Machine is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, you can banish Two-for-One Repair Job from your GY to Special Summon 1 Engine Token.
Foolish Burial (Limited) dumps Motor Shell or Fiendish Engine Omega to activate Two-for-One Repair Job without using your Normal Summon.

allow.Scrap Recycler: Level 3 EARTH Machine starter that sends Motor Shell or Fiendish Engine Omega from the Deck to the GY (setting up Two-for-One Repair Job) and recycles Level 4 EARTH Machines.
allow.Therion \"King\" Regulus: Equips Motor Shell or Scrap Recycler from the GY to Special Summon itself and provide omni-negation (and if Motor Shell leaves the field while equipped, it generates an Engine Token!).
allow.Clockwork Night: Continuous Spell searched by Clockwork Knight that turns all monsters on the field into Machines, boosts your Machines by 500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Scrap Recycler or Therion "King" Regulus.
allow.Foolish Burial: Sends Motor Shell or Fiendish Engine Omega to the GY to enable Two-for-One Repair Job (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Clockwork Knight: Link-1 EARTH Machine that can be summoned using a Level 1 EARTH Machine Engine Token, searches Clockwork Night, and tributes a Machine to revive an EARTH Machine.
allow.Link Spider: Link-1 EARTH Cyberse summoned using an Engine Token to convert tokens into Effect Monsters for Link climbing.
allow.Ancient Gear Ballista: Link-2 EARTH Machine made using two EARTH Machine Engine Tokens that pops a Spell/Trap to drop an opposing monster to 0 ATK/DEF.
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine made with Motor Shell + Engine Token that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Machine from the hand.
